title: SPI loopback: one jumper on the LP-EM-CC2340R5
warning: Probe stays clipped on; no power change needed

label: Fit one jumper from pin 15 (DIO13, SPI MOSI)
to pin 14 (DIO12, SPI MISO), header J2.
The two pins sit next to each other, so a
2.54 mm shunt or a short female wire works.
What goes out on MOSI then comes back on MISO
